historyActions.screenReaderAction: The product defines a reader action in code. The device used native touch gestures.
historyActions.iPhoneActionBasis: The iPhone HealthView source invokes archive from swipe and contextual menu actions. Its recorded three-mode visit was read-only.
historyActions.harmonyActionBasis: The HarmonyOS captures include the confirmation and the named Cancel button after each touch gesture.

earlierIndependentSample.scope: The original native screen contained the correct title and response. The first checker expected a different native message-ID prefix. The fixture was cleaned before a Back gesture.

intake.angularSampling: Changes relative to the initial 720-point native circular RGB profile, at 91% of the real Progress radius. The two rounded arc caps are present in every frame.
